chapter_path_zh: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
display_chapter_path: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
content.stem: 沃尔夫斯堡集团关于私人银行业务的反洗钱原则包括以下哪项内容？

options.A: 协助在数据隐私标准较高的司法管辖区开展业务的金融机构与易受洗钱影响的行业合作
options.B: 建议银行只接受资金来源和受益所有权已了解的客户
options.C: 为私人银行家制定有关如何处理政治公众人物（PEP）和来自高风险国家人士的规则
options.D: 要求银行更好地管理声誉风险并保护富裕客户的隐私

content.stem_en: The Wolfsberg Group's AML Principles on Private Banking:

options_en.A: Assist financial institutions conducting business in jurisdictions with high data privacy standards in working with industries susceptible to money laundering
options_en.B: Advise banks to accept only those clients whose source of funds and beneficial ownership is understood
options_en.C: Establish rules for private bankers on how to deal with politically exposed persons (PEPs) and persons residing in high-risk countries
options_en.D: Require banks to better manage reputational risk and protect the privacy of wealthy clients
